Note: The job is a remote job and is open to candidates in USA. Marquee is building an AI-native operating system for professional sports organizations, aiming to improve critical workflows in football. They are seeking a senior commercial leader to drive their business development across Europe and Asia, focusing on managing complex commercial processes and building relationships with professional football clubs.

Responsibilities

- Own Marquee’s business development and commercial activity across Europe and Asia
- Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of professional football clubs, club groups, leagues and strategic partners
- Open doors through an existing network of senior decision-makers across professional football
- Lead the full commercial process: discovery, product demonstrations, pilot design, proposals, negotiations and closing
- Sell directly to club owners, CEOs, sporting directors, technical directors, heads of recruitment and heads of data and analytics
- Develop the right commercial approach for Tier 1 clubs, mid-market clubs and clubs in smaller football markets
- Represent Marquee at industry events, club meetings and strategic partnership discussions
- Provide structured market feedback to the product, data and leadership teams
- Build a repeatable commercial process that can later support a wider regional team

[Apply Job!](https://remotejobs.victorytuitions.in/job/remote-head-of-business-development-europe-asia-4dcab52c/)

Skills

- Significant commercial or business development experience within professional football
- A proven record of closing commercial deals directly with professional football clubs across different tiers and league profiles
- Existing relationships with senior decision-makers across European or Asian football
- Clear understanding of how clubs operate across recruitment, scouting, sporting management and data analysis
- Experience managing long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing meaningful annual agreements
- High level of independence, urgency and commercial ownership
- Willingness to travel regularly across Europe and Asia
- Professional fluency in English
- Experience selling football data, analytics, scouting, recruitment or performance technology
- Experience selling SaaS or enterprise software to sporting departments
- Experience designing and converting pilot programs into annual commercial agreements
- Knowledge of club procurement, data licensing and technology implementation processes
- Additional European or Asian languages

Benefits

- Direct access to the founders and involvement in major strategic decisions
- Significant ownership over Marquee’s expansion across Europe and Asia
- Competitive base salary, performance-based compensation and equity participation for the right candidate
- Remote.

Company Overview

[Apply Job!](https://remotejobs.victorytuitions.in/job/remote-head-of-business-development-europe-asia-4dcab52c/) Marquee AI is a Sports tech company that develops advanced AI platforms to analyze recruitment, scouting and performance of the player. It was founded in 2025, and is headquartered in New York, New York, USA, with a workforce of 2-10 employees. Its website is https://www.themarquee.ai/.
